name: jimcresswell-personal-sites
description: Jim Cresswell's personal sites, with the shared Practice tooling and @engraph/* packages
author: @jimcresswell

scripts.check:fix: pnpm format:fix && pnpm markdownlint:fix && pnpm lint:shell && pnpm lint:fix && pnpm type-check && pnpm test && pnpm portability:check && pnpm subagents:check
scripts.check:ci: pnpm format && pnpm markdownlint:check && pnpm lint:shell && pnpm lint && pnpm type-check && pnpm test && pnpm portability:check && pnpm subagents:check
scripts.lint:shell: for f in .husky/pre-commit .husky/commit-msg .husky/prepare-commit-msg .husky/pre-merge-commit .husky/applypatch-msg .husky/pre-rebase .husky/pre-push .husky/refuse-commit-on-main.sh; do sh -n "$f" || exit "$?"; done
